summary: i-gRINN is a redesigned web server and application for protein energy network analysis, extending the original gRINN concept. It supports GROMACS trajectory analysis, PDB structural ensembles, standard amino acids, small-molecule ligands, and non-standard residues. Users provide structure, topology, and trajectory files to automate residue-pair energy calculations via GROMACS. The system performs frame-by-frame interaction-energy and network analysis, calculating metrics like degree, betweenness, and closeness centrality. Outputs are CSV-formatted for machine learning integration. An interactive dashboard offers visualizations of energy matrices, pairwise energies, network metrics, and 3D structures. A natural-language interface powered by large language models enables biologically grounded queries. Local deployment,
title: i-gRINN
